prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move sign-in to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate creation so users experience core value before authenticating. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users upfront; deferring account creation until after pet customization builds emotional investment.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Choice Cards Grid: Redesign the pet picker into a structured grid layout with clear choice cards and action triggers. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate (60.9%) and long mean time (1017s); a clear grid design reduces choice paralysis.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Control Guide Screen: Add a dedicated screen explaining desktop controls, key shortcuts, and hiding/showing the pet prior to final intro. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
3: [home, new_flow] Animated Companion Arrival Flow: Transform the waiting screen into a stage layout with animated setup indicators and desktop readiness notifications. (why: Home phase mean time is 2336s and 3 support tickets report pets failing to appear on desktop during launch.)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Split Screen Story Welcome: Redesign the initial story onboarding screen into a modern split layout with mascot visuals and quick completion timing. (why: Choose path step has a high mean duration (514s); a clearer welcoming layout sets quick expectations.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Warning Hint: Add clear hint text on the sign-in screen reminding users to use the same account to prevent missing pets. (why: 8 support tickets (largest theme) cited lost or reset pets after signing back in under a different account.)
6: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Upload Tip Carousel & Guidance: Provide photo upload quality guidance with dynamic tips while generating custom pets. (why: 3 support messages complained about custom pet generation failures or distorted results.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Readiness Confirmation Copy: Update final screen headline and messaging to explicitly confirm the pet is running on the user's desktop. (why: Finish stage mean time is 5815s with drop-offs occurring near completion due to confusion on desktop state.)
